Title: Generally Available: Enhanced document expiration with Time to Live (TTL) on any field.

Body.Content:
Gain exceptional control over your data expiration with this new feature designed to provide you with the ability to set a custom Time to Live (TTL) on any field in a collection, ensuring you are only storing the documents you want. This new feature seamlessly expires data based on the date set in the field. This powerful feature effortlessly adapts to your unique requirements and gives you customized, fine-grained control over document expiration at any level.

Learn More
